```{r}
#Load libraies
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(dunn.test)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggtext)
library(tidyr)
library(markdown)
library(dplyr)

#Colors
color_palette <- c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B", "Glucose" = "#817E9F" )

# Plotting
box_fill <- c("#949494", "#D2F0E3", "#C7E7D0", "#B3DAC0",
              "#A0D2AF", "#98C7A5", "#7FC29B", "darkgreen")

# Prepare base theme
base_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"),
    strip.text.x = element_markdown(size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size =11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.75))

#Set the levels of the experiment
Microbes_levels<-c("MF", "F16")

Treatment_levels<-c ("Water","3OMG")
labels <- c(
  'MF' = "Microbe free"
)
```

# A] Barplot stacked

```{r}
#Load data
data_3OMG <- read.csv("df.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
```

## 1) Full plot stats

```{r}
my_order <- c("Water_MF","Glucose_MF","3OMG_MF",
              "Water_FSC","Glucose_FSC","3OMG_FSC")

# Summarize by Microbes + Treatment
summary_tbl <- data_3OMG %>%
  group_by(Microbes, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_SFW = mean(SFW, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_SFW   = sd(SFW, na.rm = TRUE),
    N        = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

summary_tbl$concat <- paste0(summary_tbl$Treatment, "_", summary_tbl$Microbes)
summary_tbl$concat <- factor(summary_tbl$concat, levels = my_order)

data_3OMG$concat <- paste0(data_3OMG$Treatment, "_", data_3OMG$Microbes)
data_3OMG$concat <- factor(data_3OMG$concat, levels = my_order)

# Summarize by replicate (one dot per replicate)
replicate_jitter <- data_3OMG %>%
  group_by(concat, Pots) %>%  
  summarise(SFW_rep = mean(SFW, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

results <- data_3OMG %>%
  wilcox_test(SFW ~ concat, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = as.numeric(factor(group1, levels = my_order)),
    xmax = as.numeric(factor(group2, levels = my_order)),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    label = paste0("P = ", formatC(p.adj, format = "e", digits = 1))
  )

y_position <- seq(30, 30 + 3*(nrow(results)-1), by = 3)
results$y_position <- y_position

plot <- ggplot(summary_tbl, aes(x = concat, y = Mean_SFW, fill = concat)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(data = replicate_jitter, 
              aes(x = concat, y = SFW_rep), 
              width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_SFW - SD_SFW, ymax = Mean_SFW + SD_SFW),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax,
                   y = y_position, yend = y_position),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin,
                   y = y_position, yend = y_position - 0.8),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax,
                   y = y_position, yend = y_position - 0.8),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = results,
            aes(x = xmid,
                y = y_position + 1.4,
                label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = summary_tbl,
            aes(x = concat,
                y = -2,
                label = paste0("n = ", N)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Treatment + Microbes", y = "SFW") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Water_MF"   = "darkgray",
    "Water_FSC"  = "darkgray",
    "Glucose_MF" = "#817E9F",
    "Glucose_FSC"= "#817E9F",
    "3OMG_FSC"   = "#7FC29B",
    "3OMG_MF"    = "#7FC29B"
  )) +
  base_theme

plot
```
## 2) Plots MF 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)

my_order <- c("Water_MF","Glucose_MF","3OMG_MF")

# Keep only Microbe-free
data_MF <- data_3OMG %>%
  filter(Microbes == "MF") %>%
  mutate(concat = paste0(Treatment, "_", Microbes),
         concat = factor(concat, levels = my_order))

summary_tbl <- data_MF %>%
  group_by(Microbes, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_SFW = mean(SFW, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_SFW   = sd(SFW, na.rm = TRUE),
    N        = n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(concat = paste0(Treatment, "_", Microbes),
         concat = factor(concat, levels = my_order))

# Summarize by replicate (one dot per replicate)
replicate_jitter <- data_MF %>%
  group_by(concat, Pots) %>%  
  summarise(SFW_rep = mean(SFW, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Wilcoxon test
results <- data_MF %>%
  wilcox_test(SFW ~ concat, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = as.numeric(factor(group1, levels = my_order)),
    xmax = as.numeric(factor(group2, levels = my_order)),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    label = paste0("P = ", formatC(p.adj, format = "e", digits = 1))
  )

# Keep same y_position logic as previous plot
y_position <- seq(30, 30 + 3*(nrow(results)-1), by = 3)
results$y_position <- y_position

plot <- ggplot(summary_tbl, aes(x = concat, y = Mean_SFW, fill = concat)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(data = replicate_jitter, 
              aes(x = concat, y = SFW_rep), 
              width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_SFW - SD_SFW, ymax = Mean_SFW + SD_SFW),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax,
                   y = y_position, yend = y_position),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin,
                   y = y_position, yend = y_position - 0.8),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = results,
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax,
                   y = y_position, yend = y_position - 0.8),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = results,
            aes(x = xmid,
                y = y_position + 1.4,
                label = p.adj.signif),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = replicate_jitter,
            aes(x = concat,
                y = -2,
                label = paste0("n = ", 4)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Treatment (Microbe-free)", y = "SFW") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Water_MF"   = "darkgray",
    "Glucose_MF" = "#817E9F",
    "3OMG_MF"    = "#7FC29B"
  )) +
  base_theme

plot
```

#  B] Reduced plot

## 1) Boxplot
```{r}
#Load data
data_3OMG <- read.csv("df.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

#Subset what we need
data_3OMG2 <- subset(data_3OMG, !(Microbes == "MF" & Treatment %in% c("3OMG", "Glucose")))
data_3OMG2 <- subset(data_3OMG2, !(Treatment %in% c("Glucose")))

#Concat comparisons
data_3OMG2$Conditions <- paste0(data_3OMG2$Treatment, "_", data_3OMG2$Microbes)
```

```{r}
# Calculate mean disease index per Experiment × Treatment
data_3OMG2 <- data_3OMG2 %>%
  group_by(Pots, Conditions) %>%
  summarise(OverallSFW = mean(SFW), .groups = "drop")

# Example: pairwise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("Water_MF", "Water_FSC"),
  c("Water_MF", "3OMG_FSC"),
  c("Water_FSC", "3OMG_FSC")
)


#T.test assumptions
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)   # for outlier detection, normality, variance tests
library(ggplot2)

# Check normality per Treatment
normality_table <- data_3OMG2 %>%
  group_by(Conditions) %>%
  summarise(
    Shapiro_p = shapiro.test(OverallSFW)$p.value,
    Normal = ifelse(Shapiro_p > 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

normality_table #Normal

# Optional: Q-Q plots per treatment
qqplot <- ggplot(data_3OMG2, aes(sample = OverallSFW)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Conditions) +
  theme_bw() #ok

# Check equality of variance (homoscedasticity) using Levene's test
levene_test <- data_3OMG2 %>%
  levene_test(OverallSFW ~ Conditions)

levene_test # no difference of variance

# Compute p-values for each comparison. I do a wilcoxon test
pvals <- sapply(comparisons, function(comp) {
  data_sub <- data_3OMG2 %>% filter(Conditions %in% comp)
  test <- t.test(OverallSFW ~ Conditions, data = data_sub)
  p <- test$p.value
  if (p < 0.001) {
    "P < 0.001"
  } else if (p >= 0.05) {
    "ns"
  } else {
    paste0("P = ", signif(p, 2))
  }
})

pvals


# Define y positions for the bars
y_positions <- c(42, 45, 39)

# Count number of replicates per Conditions
n_reps <- data_3OMG2 %>%
  group_by(Conditions) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

#Order the conditions
data_3OMG2$Conditions <- factor(data_3OMG2$Conditions, levels = c("Water_MF","Water_FSC", "3OMG_FSC"))


# Create the boxplot with Wilcoxon stats
boxp <- ggplot(data_3OMG2, aes(x =Conditions , y =  OverallSFW, fill = Conditions)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Conditions",
    y = "Overall Disease Index (mean per Experiment)",
    fill = "Conditions"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    annotations = pvals,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    y_position = y_positions,
    tip_length = 0.03,
    col = "black",
    size = 0.4
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Water_MF" = "darkgray", "Water_FSC" = "red4", "3OMG_FSC" = "#7FC29B")) +
  geom_text(data = n_reps, aes(x = Conditions, y = -1, label = label), size = 3)

boxp
```



## 2) Barplot
```{r}
#Summarize data
overall_sum <- data_3OMG2 %>%
  group_by(Conditions) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_OD = mean(OverallSFW, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_OD   = sd(OverallSFW, na.rm = TRUE),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define y positions for the bars
y_positions <- c(28, 32, 30)

#Add column for facet title
overall_sum$Disease.2 <- c("Fungal SynCom (Root rot)")    

#Plot
barp_at <- ggplot(overall_sum, aes(x = Conditions, y = mean_OD, fill = Conditions)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_OD - sd_OD,ymax = mean_OD + sd_OD),width = 0.2) +
  # Raw data points
  geom_jitter(data = data_3OMG2,aes(x = Conditions, y = OverallSFW), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Shoot Fresh Weight (mg)",
    fill = "Treatment") +
  base_theme +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    annotations = pvals,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    y_position = y_positions,
    tip_length = 0.03,
    col = "black",
    size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Water_MF" = "darkgray", "Water_FSC" = "darkgray", "3OMG_FSC" = "#7FC29B"),
                    labels = c("Water_MF"  = "Control (Water)", "Water_FSC" = "Control (FSC)", "3OMG_FSC"  = "3OMG (FSC)")) +
  geom_text(
    data = overall_sum,
    aes(x = Conditions, y = -0.8, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid (~  Disease.2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Water_MF"   = "Control (Water)", "Water_FSC"  = "Control (FSC)", "3OMG_FSC"   = "3OMG (FSC)")) +
  ylim(-0.8,34)

barp_at
```
